definitions.gloss: banquet hall; party venue; function room
definitions.explanation: A room or hall specifically designed or designated for hosting banquets, parties, and other gatherings.

examples.japanese: {宴会場|えんかいじょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{予約|よやく}した→予約する：22989_yoyakusuru⟧。
⟦ホテル→ホテル：01027_hoteru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{宴会場|えんかいじょう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{結婚|けっこん}→結婚：02514_kekkon⟧⟦{披露宴|ひろうえん}→披露宴：05636_hirouen⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{行|おこな}われた→行う：01238_okonau⟧。
examples.english: The wedding reception was held in the hotel's banquet hall.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧{宴会場|えんかいじょう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{最大|さいだい}→最大：04827_saidai⟧{三百人|さんびゃくにん}⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦{収容|しゅうよう}→収容：11800_shuuyou⟧⟦できる→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: This banquet hall can accommodate up to 300 people.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{宴会|えんかい}→宴会：04104_enkai⟧ (banquet, party) and {場|じょう} (place, venue). Found in hotels, traditional Japanese inns, and dedicated event facilities. Hotels and ryokan typically have dedicated {宴会場|えんかいじょう} for corporate events, wedding receptions, and year-end parties.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {大|だい}{宴会場|えんかいじょう}: large banquet hall
- {宴会場|えんかいじょう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{予約|よやく}→予約：01522_yoyaku⟧: banquet hall reservation
- {宴会場|えんかいじょう}⟦{付|つ}き→付き：26333_tsuki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ホテル→ホテル：01027_hoteru⟧: hotel with a banquet hall

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{宴会|えんかい}→宴会：04104_enkai⟧: banquet, party — the event itself
- ⟦{披露宴|ひろうえん}→披露宴：05636_hirouen⟧: wedding reception
- ⟦{忘年会|ぼうねんかい}→忘年会：15800_bounenkai⟧: year-end party — one of the most common uses for a banquet hall
- ⟦{会場|かいじょう}→会場：01269_kaijou⟧: venue — more general term for any event venue
